neighbours.label: A lone single-space token: the bare space right before digits (' 12', ' 3.5') or the extra space of a double space between words or sentences. Quiet when digits are glued to a symbol ('$40', '(40)', '-3', 'x=5'), for numbers written as words, and for runs of three or more spaces; weaker before a year after a month name ('April 1991').
neighbours.short: the bare space token (before digits, or a double space)
fire: We ordered 12 pizzas for the party.
The recipe calls for 3.5 cups of flour.
She finished the race in 47 minutes.
Turn to page 208 and read the first paragraph.
The bus leaves at 7 every morning.
He scored 3 goals in the final match.
The meeting ran long.  Everyone was tired afterward.
I left the keys on the  kitchen table.
